Below the title, there are six smaller images arranged in a grid-like pattern, each with a different color scheme. 

The first image on the top left shows the woman's eyes before and after the film, with the left image showing her eyes looking out the window and the right image showing the same woman looking through the window. The second image in the top right shows her eyes with a serious expression. The third image shows a closer look at her eyes, with a hint of a cityscape in the background.

At the bottom of the poster, there is a text in Chinese that translates to "Image 2.5" in English. The text also mentions that the film will be released in 4K resolution.
